items: Leashed babies follow you in single file along your path on the ground, and scatter when you're attacked
Babies left far behind catch up with you in seconds, and their leashes aren't drawn
A baby only eats a berry when you put its sigil down within 10 m of one (those berries glow brightly while a baby's sigil is next to go down), and one berry makes it a youth
Eight babies are free to carry on the ground and in the treetops, whatever their kind
